rounds.prompt: In 2025, how long did it take Amazon, on average, to sell $1 million worth of stuff?
rounds.source: Amazon.com Inc. Form 10-K for 2025 (SEC filing): net sales of $716,924 million

rounds.prompt: If you went to a different pub every night, how many years would it take to visit every pub in the UK today?
rounds.source: British Beer & Pub Association: 44,656 UK pubs in 2025, about 122 years at one a night

rounds.prompt: How many Rubik's Cubes have been sold?
rounds.source: Spin Master, owner of the Rubik's brand, via Fortune (December 2024): roughly 500 million cubes sold since launch
